title: TCS New York City Marathon 2026
description: The world's largest marathon with 60,000+ runners through all five NYC boroughs. A bucket-list race celebrating its 50th anniversary course.
long_description: The TCS New York City Marathon is the world's largest marathon and one of the six World Marathon Majors. Over 60,000 runners from 130+ countries cross the Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge and run through all five boroughs — Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Manhattan — before the iconic Central Park finish. The 2026 edition marks the 50th anniversary of the five-borough course. Two million spectators line the streets, making it arguably the most electrifying marathon atmosphere on Earth. The race has raised over $600 million for charity since 2006.
venue_info: Start: Fort Wadsworth, Staten Island (ferry/bus transport from Manhattan). Finish: Central Park, near Tavern on the Green. Subway serves the finish area (B/C to 72nd St). Entry is by lottery, charity, or guaranteed qualifier. 59,226 finishers in 2025.
